meta.source_file: Abhijeet Sangle_Data Visualization Analyst-Power BI Developer_Intileo_segmented.txt

summary:
Power BI Developer with 5.9+ years of experience in designing
enterprise-level dashboards, data visualization, business intelligence
solutions, and analytics reporting across Finance, HR, Lounge Operations,
Supply Chain, Incentive Management, and Elite Club membership domains.
Skilled in developing interactive dashboards using Microsoft Power BI,
advanced DAX, Power Query, SQL, and Power Platform technologies to
deliver actionable business insights and improve decision-making.
Experienced in dashboard optimization, data modeling, governance, RLS
implementation, ETL integration, and enterprise reporting solutions.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(Requirements Elicitation→Requirements Gathering(100%), Sigma→Sigma Computing(100%))

bullets: Designed and developed advanced Power BI dashboards using complex DAX, dynamic parameters, and scenario-driven business logic.
Gathered and analyzed business requirements from cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring that all reports and visualizations aligned with organizational goals and delivered relevant KPIs.
Monitored and optimized Power BI datasets, DAX queries, semantic models, and report behavior to enhance report responsiveness and reduce refresh times.
Conducted end-to-end troubleshooting and root cause analysis for dashboard failures, refresh issues, gateway connectivity problems, and server performance bottlenecks.
Built dynamic slicers using parameter tables, supporting scenario filtering (ACTatPLAN, PLAN, FCST, etc.).
Implemented governance best practices including role-based access control (RBAC), audit monitoring, workspace management, and data security compliance.
Developed executive-level finance dashboards for revenue tracking, profitability analysis, budget utilization, and financial KPI monitoring.
Built Actual vs Forecast reporting with variance analysis using advanced DAX calculations.
Created drill-through reports for department-wise expense and revenue analysis.
Developed incentive calculation dashboards to track employee incentive payouts, achievements, targets, and performance metrics.
Built dynamic KPI scorecards and ranking visuals for leadership visibility.
Implemented row-level security for role-based access.
Conducted knowledge transfer sessions with end-users to explain dashboard functionalities, enable data-driven decision-making, and enhance business intelligence practices.
Transformed static Excel reports into dynamic Power BI dashboards, streamlining reporting processes.
Conducted data profiling and cleansing initiatives, resulting in an improvement in data accuracy and relevance for reporting.
Assisted in developing data dictionaries and supporting documentation, enhancing data transparency and reducing onboarding time for new analysts.
Utilized Power Query in Power BI to Pivot and Unpivot the data model for data cleansing and data massaging
Implemented RLS (Row Level Security) on many reports by using Manage Roles and adding users into those roles in Power BI Service as per the Business Requirements.
Executed platform upgrades, patch management, migration activities, and environment validation with minimal business disruption.
Dedicated Mechanical Engineering Professor with a decade of expertise in curriculum design, student mentoring, and technical research.
